name: io.fiscalbase/mcp-sandbox
title: Fiscalbase Sandbox
description: Fiscalbase on a simulated SRI: try Ecuador's e-invoices from an agent, with no tax validity.

tools.name: fiscalbase_me
tools.description: Call this first, once. Returns who you act for (`credential`: the person's role, and whether this connection reads or also writes), the one business and whether it can issue now (`blockers` say what it lacks), its `establishments` with their emission points (ids to number a document at), this month's `usage` against the plan, and a `playbook`: the calls and formats of the usual tasks.

tools.name: fiscalbase_docs
tools.description:
Fiscalbase's documentation, for what the playbook of fiscalbase_me doesn't cover. `action`:
- "guide": how to issue a `type`: its rules, an example and every field of its body. The same text as the resource fiscalbase://guides/{type}.
- "search": searches docs.fiscalbase.io (in Spanish) for `query`: SRI rules and refusals, credit notes, webhooks, imports, the recipient portal, plans and billing. Returns pages with the section that matched.
- "read": a page by its `url` from a search, as Markdown. A long page comes in parts: pass `next_offset` as `offset` to read on.

tools.name: ec_lookup_taxpayer
tools.description: Turns a RUC (13 digits) or `cédula` (10 digits) into the `buyer` (or `supplier`) object of a document: the name the SRI registers and the head office address. `buyer.email` stays empty: `suggested_email` is the email this business used before for this exact identification, which you propose to the person and use only once they confirm it; with none, ask for one. For a RUC it also returns the SRI's record (`taxpayer`): status, regime, `contribuyente especial`, withholding agent.

tools.name: ec_find
tools.description:
Searches the business, most recent first, in concise rows with ids. `resource`:
- "documents": issued, by `type`, `status`, `counterparty_identification`, `q` (number, access key or name), `issue_date` and where they were numbered. ec_get_document reads one whole.
- "received_documents": what suppliers issued to it, by `type`, `q`, `counterparty_identification` (the issuer's RUC) and `issue_date`.
- "contacts": who it issues to, by `q` (name words or identification), with the email last used.
- "suppliers": who issued to it, by `q`.
- "products": its catalog, by `q` (words, code or barcode).
- "line_suggestions": lines it issued before, by `q`: description, codes, `unit_price` before IVA, taxes. One `type` (default invoices).
- "series": each emission point and type: who issues there, last number, `gaps`. One `type`.

A filter a resource doesn't take is refused. `next_cursor` reads on as `cursor`.

tools.name: ec_get_document
tools.description:
Reads documents by id, issued or received, up to 10 at once: every field, the SRI's messages, an issued one's `timeline`, and links to the XML and PDF (read them only when needed). `wait_seconds` (up to 25) waits for the SRI's decision on a `pending` or `submitted` document.

Statuses: `pending` and `submitted` are on their way; `authorized` is final; `returned` and `not_authorized` were refused (do what each message's `remedy` says; when it says to resubmit, ec_document_action "resubmit"); `annulled`.

tools.name: ec_preview_document
ec_issue_document
tools.description:
Issues a document: it is numbered, signed and sent to the SRI and, once authorized, emailed on its own to its recipient when the document names their email. Send one of: `type` and `document` (ec_preview_document's format), `draft_id` (a saved draft), or `quote_id` (a quote, as its factura). With the `preview_id` of a preview, the API issues exactly the document previewed, or refuses with preview_mismatch.

`idempotency_key`: a new UUID per document, and the same one to retry after a timeout, so a retry never issues twice. `wait_seconds` (up to 25) waits for the SRI's decision. Returns the status, number, SRI messages (each with a cause and a remedy), `next_step` and, once authorized, links to the XML and PDF.

idempotency_key.description: A new UUID per document; the same one only to retry.

tools.name: ec_document_action
tools.description:
Acts on one issued document by `id`. `action`:
- "email": emails its XML and PDF again, to its recipient or to `to` (up to 10 addresses).
- "refresh_status": asks the SRI now about a `submitted` document, at most once every 10 seconds.
- "resubmit": sends a corrected `returned` or `not_authorized` document with the same number; `document` is the whole corrected body.
- "renumber": a `returned` document whose number the SRI already has (message 45) takes the next one; automatic in `sandbox`.
- "annul": records an annulment made in the SRI's portal: `annulled_on` (YYYY-MM-DD) and optionally `reason`.

Returns the document afterwards, concise.

tools.name: ec_report
tools.description:
What the business issued, at a glance. `view`:
- "period" (default): a period's documents, the current month in Ecuador by default: how many and for how much, by status and by type, the refused ones grouped by the SRI's message with its cause and remedy, and `sri`: whether the SRI is slow right now, so you know whether to wait before retrying. Optionally one `establishment_id`. For "how did this month go" or "what was refused and why".
- "habits": how it usually issues, over the last 90 days by default (a year at most), by type: the usual emission points, payment methods, IVA rates, additional information and kinds of buyer, with counts and the latest documents' ids. Only when the person leaves a document open ("the usual invoice"): mirror the majority and say so. Never take the buyer, quantities or prices from it.

tools.name: ec_suggest_withholding
tools.description:
Proposes the `comprobante de retención` for a supplier's invoice: the `supplier` and the `support_documents` entry (invoice, totals, tax support, each renta and IVA withholding). Put both in ec_preview_document's `document` with type "withholding"; check the renta code against what was bought (catalog `renta_withholdings`).

Name the invoice one way: its 49-digit `access_key`, `received_document_id` (a row of ec_find "received_documents"), or `invoice` with its issuer's `supplier_identification`. `kind`: "goods" (renta 312, IVA 30 %), "services" (renta 3440, IVA 70 %; labour, transport and rent have their own codes) or "professional_services" (renta 303A and IVA 70 % from a company, 303 and 100 % from a natural person). The SRI's record of the supplier (`supplier_facts`: special taxpayer, RIMPE) changes the percents. Not for a supplier abroad: fiscalbase_docs guide "withholding".

invoice.description: Without an access key: the supplier's invoice as it was issued.

taxes.description: Each `{type: iva, rate: iva_15, base, value}`.

payments.description: Each `{method, amount?}`, as in the playbook's `payment_methods`.

supplier_identification.description: Required with `invoice`, beside it: its issuer's RUC or `cédula`.

tools.name: fiscalbase_api_search
tools.description: Finds what the `ec_*` tools don't cover: every other operation of the Fiscalbase API this connection may call (products, stock, contacts, drafts, quotes, imports, received documents, catalogs, webhooks, numbering, establishments, portal, team, plan, API keys). `query`: words in English ("adjust stock", "webhook deliveries"); returns up to 10 operations with their `effect`. `operation`: one id, for its path and query parameters, its body's fields and its refusal codes. Then run it with fiscalbase_api_read (effect `read`) or fiscalbase_api_write (`write`); an `irreversible` one names the `tool` that does it.

tools.name: fiscalbase_api_read
tools.description: Runs a `read` operation of the Fiscalbase API by its id (fiscalbase_api_search finds it and lists its parameters). `path` fills the path's parameters; `query` is the API's own, a list's `limit` (at most 20) and `cursor` included; `body` only for a read that takes one. `fields` keeps only those fields of the object, or of each row of a list: send it for wide objects. Example: {"operation": "ecListCatalogEntries", "path": {"table": "payment_methods"}, "query": {"q": "tarjeta"}}

tools.name: fiscalbase_api_write
tools.description: Runs a `write` operation of the Fiscalbase API by its id: it creates, changes, deletes or revokes, as the person this connection acts for. Read it with fiscalbase_api_search {operation} first: an unknown body field is refused. `path` fills the path's parameters; `idempotency_key` (a new UUID) makes a retry safe where the operation takes one. What cannot be undone (issuing, emailing, annulling) is refused: ec_issue_document and ec_document_action do it. Example: {"operation": "ecUpdateProduct", "path": {"id": "…"}, "body": {"unit_price": "2.50"}}
